content: The mountain does not bow to the storm, yet it allows the white clouds to drape gently over its shoulders.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Classical Landscape & Shan Shui Poetry Precepts
explanation: Unyielding strength does not mean harsh, unfeeling aggression. The great granite peak withstands gale-force blizzards without budging an inch, yet it welcomes the softest mist and shelters fragile moss. True strength combines iron resolve with gentle hospitality.
practicalInsight: Be unshakeable in your core ethical principles, but gentle and warm in your manners toward everyone you meet today.
reflectionPrompt: How can you cultivate strength that is firm without being cold, and steadfast without being rigid?
